'''James Ray''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 76 from Mentor, Oh. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Born in 1950, he holds a PhD in Chemistry from Cornell. He became a tournament director in mid-1997 and joined the squadron months later, ran family-supported tournaments east of Cleveland, and helped [[Ryan Patterson]] start out.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
I became a sanctioned tournament director in mid-1997 in the hopes of recruiting more local sanctioned TDs, and joined the squadron ranks a few months later.

Certainly, one of the means is to foster a robust, vibrant environment that mentors the beginners and challenges the veterans.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
